recommendations.section: ## 3. L2 (### 3.4 Trained stated confidence is now a concrete threat on code)
recommendations.current: General NLP points the same way. Probe-SD distills a probe into the verbal channel and lifts Qwen3-14B's verbal AUROC on TriviaQA from .825 to .928 in domain against a probe at .948, while isotonic recalibration cuts ECE from .178 to .013 but leaves AUROC at .825 (Tables 1 and 2) [[calibration-not-answer-selection-distilling-internal-confidence-in-reasoning-mod]]. RLCR, which adds a Brier reward to RL with verifiable rewards (RLVR), reaches verbal AUROC 0.69 against 0.55 for a final-layer probe on the RLVR model on HotpotQA, and 0.67 against 0.65 on Big-Math (Table 1) [[beyond-binary-rewards-training-lms-to-reason-about-their-uncertainty-2]]. ConfTuner reports AUROC gains of up to 14.4% [[conftuner-training-large-language-models-to-express-their-confidence-verbally]].
recommendations.recommended: General NLP points the same way. Probe-SD lifts Qwen3-14B's verbal AUROC on TriviaQA from .825 to .928 in domain against a probe at .948, while isotonic recalibration leaves AUROC at .825 (Tables 1 and 2) [[calibration-not-answer-selection-distilling-internal-confidence-in-reasoning-mod]]; RLCR's Brier reward reaches verbal AUROC 0.69 against 0.55 for a final-layer probe on HotpotQA (Table 1) [[beyond-binary-rewards-training-lms-to-reason-about-their-uncertainty-2]]; and ConfTuner reports AUROC gains of up to 14.4% [[conftuner-training-large-language-models-to-express-their-confidence-verbally]].

recommendations.section: ## 1. Scope, instruments, and verdict rules (### 1.3 Instruments, and why every CLEAN is provisional)
recommendations.current: The search instruments failed in specific, documented ways. arXiv full-text search failed validation, OpenAlex full-text search found one of two known positives before its budget ran out, Semantic Scholar keyword search was rate-limited throughout, and OpenReview sits behind a browser challenge. Every negative that depends on body-text search is therefore an instrument gap, never a zero, and no CLEAN verdict here is unconditional. Section 10 gives each gap, the verdicts it weakens, and the action that would close it.
